rounds.text: Pratham EPC Projects Ltd carries an extreme valuation that is completely detached from its current operational reality, trading at a staggering P/E ratio of 134x to 143.53x against a sector benchmark of just 15.91x [E1, E6]. This massive multiple sits on top of collapsing fundamentals, highlighted by a trailing twelve months compounded sales growth of -25% [E14] and decelerating earnings growth [E61]. Furthermore, profitability has plummeted to an abysmal ROE of 1.8% to 1.9% [E8, E11], completely dwarfed by the sector benchmark ROE of 9.51% [E8] and falling precipitously from its historical three-year median of 13% [E20] and five-year median of 18% [E19]. Market expectations are dangerously disconnected from delivery, with price growth exceeding profit growth by 70% [E50], leaving the stock sitting at a lowly 15% of its 52-week range [E5] while offering a completely nonexistent dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated solid historical top-line expansion, achieving a compounded sales growth of 24% over 5 years [E12] and 21% over 3 years [E13].
